x: The Club 10 mile Championship for the R Murphy Shield was decided at Wimbledon on Feb. 7th and in the absence of the holder H F. King who is now in the Gold Coast of West Africa and his "runner up" last year, F.
We congratulate our 20 mile Champion, F. Rickard, who successfully defended his title of “National Police Champion” in the Barking—Southend Walk.
Fortunately the worst of the weather had passed when a small field of eleven started. King and Green forced the pace followed by F. Rickard (holder for the three previous years) and E.

King also at a maiden attempt did quite well to finish 7th, So, with a repetition of this form and with E G Cooper and F Rickard at their best we need not fear but that next year we shall be fighting back to regain the lost.
Green secured fastest loser's prize in the Southern Railway Worthing to Brighton handicap F Rickard was placed 7th in the All England Police 10 mile championship, and was in the winning team.

It goes without saying that Tommy as a member of the winning Belgrave team was always in the awards, and together with his close companions of those days Fred Rickard and Fred Bentley, provided an unbeatable trio.
